name: Dominique Thomas-St.Ville
subject: Join the Agency
message:
Hello! 

I’m a dedicated and versatile actor, bringing a strong commitment to storytelling, emotional authenticity, and collaborative creativity.
My training and experience have allowed me to develop a wide range of performances across stage and screen. I am particularly drawn to complex, character-driven roles that explore human vulnerability, resilience, and transformation. I pride myself on my ability to fully inhabit a role, take direction with precision, and contribute meaningfully to the overall vision of a project.
In addition to my acting skills, I maintain a professional and reliable work ethic. I understand the importance of preparation, adaptability, and presence both on and off set. Whether working within an ensemble or carrying a central role, I approach each opportunity with focus and respect for the craft.
I would welcome the chance to audition and demonstrate how I can contribute to your production. Thank you for your time and consideration.
Sincerely, 
Dominique Thomas-St.Ville
